text: The road to our village becomes completely unusable during monsoon. Ambulances cannot reach us.
हमारे गांव की सड़क बारिश में खराब हो जाती है। स्कूल बस नहीं आ पाती।
No proper road connecting our village to the primary health centre. Patients suffer.
మా గ్రామం నుండి ఆసుపత్రికి రోడ్డు లేదు. వర్షాకాలంలో చాలా కష్టం.
School buses cannot reach the village because of the broken road stretch.
Drinking water pipeline has been broken for 3 weeks. We are fetching water from 2 km away.
पानी की पाइपलाइन टूटी हुई है। महिलाओं को दूर से पानी लाना पड़ता है।
No clean drinking water in our colony for the last 15 days.
Primary health centre has no doctor for the last two months. Only compounder available.
प्राथमिक स्वास्थ्य केंद्र में डॉक्टर नहीं हैं। मरीजों को जिला अस्पताल जाना पड़ता है।
Pregnant women have to travel 35 km for delivery because local PHC has no medical officer.
Street lights have not been working for 4 months. Women feel unsafe after dark.
सड़क की लाइटें 4 महीने से खराब हैं। रात में डर लगता है।
Open drain overflowing into the main road. Children getting sick.
Government school has no functional toilets for girls. Many drop out after class 5.
పాఠశాలలో అమ్మాయిలకు టాయిలెట్ లేదు. చాలా మంది చదువు మానేస్తున్నారు.
issue: No toilets for girls in school

text: Internet connectivity is extremely poor. Students cannot attend online classes.
Mobile network drops constantly. Digital services of government are inaccessible.
The only bridge connecting three villages is damaged and unsafe for vehicles.
During rains the bridge becomes completely impassable. People use boats.
Water tanker comes only once a week. Not enough for the whole colony.
पानी का टैंकर हफ्ते में एक बार आता है। पर्याप्त नहीं है।
No ambulance service available in our block. Emergency cases take too long.
Garbage collection has stopped for 3 weeks. Waste is piling up on streets.
Classroom roof is leaking. Children sit under plastic sheets during rain.
Road from highway to our three villages is full of deep potholes.
Hand pump is dry. Nearest working hand pump is 1.5 km away.
No specialist doctor visits our CHC. Patients referred to district hospital always.
Open defecation continues because community toilets are locked or broken.
No digital classroom facility. Students lag behind in computer literacy.
